ends.description: The page the run is on after, by its id — or unknown

at.description: Only when failed: the step the method stopped at

message.description: What LinkedIn said, word for word: a notice, an error, an empty state

evidence.description: What the page showed, in LinkedIn's terms

author.description: Whose post it is: the name in the card's header, or after `Open control menu for post by`

authorUrl.description: The author's profile address, https://www.linkedin.com/in/<slug>/, when the header links to it

group.description: The group the post was made in, when the header names one (`View group: …`)

text.description: The post's text, in full, as shown

media.description: What is attached: image, video, document, article, poll — or null

reactions.description: The count the `<n> reactions` link shows; 0 when none

comments.description: The count the `<n> comments` link shows; 0 when none

reposts.description: The count the `<n> reposts` link shows; 0 when none
